title: Unify the whole Night Roster experience
summary: The coherence redesign is now visibly expressed across the installed app, with one compact top-shell language, stronger hierarchy, less stacked-card volume and a consistent navigation and context system across Night, Changes, Breaks, Chat and Account.
changes: Turns the Night opening into one true unified shell that contains hospital identity, personalised greeting, shared shift identity and selected-night navigation instead of several visually unrelated layers.
Rebuilds Changes and Breaks into the same compound top-shell grammar, significantly reducing vertical volume while keeping selected-night, staffing and shift identity immediately readable.
Tightens the Changes workflow, personal Night card handoff, Breaks summary, Chat hierarchy and Account grouped surfaces so every destination follows the same spacing, radius and typography rhythm.
Refines the bottom dock into one quieter piece of navigation chrome with a more integrated centre Actions control and consistent selected-state treatment.
Preserves roster calculations, staffing rules, First and Second Part semantics, Malta and DST timing, authentication, database writes, clinical colours and existing guarded mutation paths.
Corrects the release boundary so installed PWAs receive 47.0 through a new versioned app shell and service-worker cache rather than silently retaining 46.2 presentation assets.
